axioms: A disputed claim between two prior findings is resolved by re-reading the cited code and doc text directly, not by weighing which lens sounded more confident.
A refuted finding still carries information: the corrected, cheaper reading of the mechanism is itself a finding worth recording, not just a retraction.
Session semantics (ordering, one-sitting requirements) must be verified against actual persisted state and re-invocation behavior, never assumed from a worked example's prose.
primitives: convergence vs contradiction against the ledger
failure_mode: Restates what one prior lens already established without adding independent verification, inflating apparent confidence without new evidence.
Is scoped to the specific dispute handed to it and will not surface adjacent defects in the same code path that neither disputing finding raised.
Cannot adjudicate disputes that were never flagged with disagreement_refs in the ledger.
